scope: Local synthetic maintenance and water-supply evidence only; no operational policy or public image release.

helper.entrypoint: preflight(data, media_type, filename, limits, decoder=None, expected_digest=None)

input.data: Nonempty immutable Python bytes; caller bounds the stream before materialization.
input.filename: ASCII alphanumeric first character, then alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen basename; .png/.jpg/.jpeg extension, case insensitive; total length <=100; reject Windows reserved device basenames. Never a storage key.

limits.note: Helper accepts explicit validated caller limits; it does not load or activate this candidate runtime policy.

input.expected_digest: Optional lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 for equality against supplied bytes only; not a malware verdict or persisted deduplication lookup.
input.decoder: Optional trusted synchronous local decoder returning exactly DecodedImage(media_type,width,height,frames). No decoder is installed or proven by this contract.

limitations: PNG signature/IHDR/CRC checks and minimal JPEG boundaries are preflight, not full decode or malware validation.
The injected decoder must enforce allocation and execution bounds during parsing; post-decode dimensions alone cannot establish those bounds.
Missing decoder, decoder exception or absent scanner policy leaves plausible input quarantined. No quarantined object is downloadable.
No database, route, persistence, encryption, file storage, revision cardinality or access-control enforcement is implemented by this helper.

candidate_local_runtime_limits.authority: Frozen candidate integration limits for independent security review; not operational policy and not an activated upload service.
candidate_local_runtime_limits.enforcement: A separately reviewed runtime must enforce streaming size, concurrent revision count, dimensions/pixels, maintained bounded decoding and scanner policy. Numeric caps here are not evidence those services exist.

runtime_requirements.text_acceptance: Independent; evidence failure must not silently discard an accepted text operation.
runtime_requirements.identity: One immutable revision and organization. Retry binds current actor, revision, operation UUID and immutable byte hash; same identity/bytes returns same private result; conflict fails without cross-account digest existence oracle.
runtime_requirements.authorization: Current authenticated actor action permission plus originating-unit/revision/organization access on upload/status/download. Administrator label, channel grant and UUID knowledge do not confer original access.
runtime_requirements.storage: Encrypted private storage outside web static/dist/media roots; server-generated opaque keys; original metadata remains private. Never trust client filename, MIME or digest as authority.
runtime_requirements.retrieval: Only validated private objects under current scope; audit success required; no-store; attachment disposition with fixed safe filename; uniform missing/inaccessible denial. No public URL, thumbnail or quarantine download.
runtime_requirements.locking_and_failure: Review lock ordering before integration; no opposing evidence/approval locks. Transaction/file compensation preserves recoverable private quarantine, never public orphaned blobs.
runtime_requirements.purge: No cleanup or retention deletion authorized by this contract.
